Offline Forecasts

Why: with no signal the app shows a blank screen. The last forecast would be enough.

PW-1 Show the last forecast when offline

What the user will notice: the app opens on the last forecast, marked with its age.

PW-2 Refresh the cache in the background

What the user will notice: the morning forecast is from the last hour.

PW-3 Say the age in words

What the user will notice: "Updated this morning" instead of "Updated 3 h ago".
